name: corridor
short: Shared services and office state for office-cogs.
description: Owns shared reply and permission settings, LLM and A2A infrastructure, registered agent tools, and the two opaque revisioned office-state aggregates used by the cctv pages. Other cogs consume these services through required_cogs.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores bot-owner configuration for shared LLM/A2A services. It also stores Discord user IDs and registered agent IDs when those identities have avatar appearance or seat assignments in either cctv office-state aggregate.
author: Tin Nguyen
